content: Brilinta (ticagrelor) is a medication classified as a P2Y12 platelet inhibitor. It works by inhibiting platelet aggregation and is approved by the FDA for the treatment of acute coronary syndromes (ACS), which include unstable angina, non-ST elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI), and ST elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI).
